title: Product on-push-main GitHub Actions workflow
description: Canonical .github/workflows/on-push-main.yml must call the shared reusable workflow sargonpiraev/ci/.github/workflows/on-push-main.yml@*. Job id is conventionally ci, or base when other jobs need the reusable run. Must not wire NPM_TOKEN / NODE_AUTH_TOKEN (Trusted Publishing / OIDC). Failures: missing shared uses; NPM_TOKEN in env/secrets (text rule); publish job without id-token: write when releasing to npm. Shipped by @sargonpiraev/eslint-config.

on.description: Must trigger on push (typically branches: [main]); additional events allowed.

uses.description: Reusable workflow from sargonpiraev/ci (any ref after @).
